result:
The DE GL 1000 bank reconciliation for March is complete. Summary of what was found and done:

- **Duplicate payment (fixed):** JE-00272/JE-00273 were duplicate postings of the same EUR 6,480 Rheinbyte Software payment; only one cleared the bank. Reversed JE-00273 (posted as JE-00309, supported by the original vendor invoice DOC-0165).
- **Unrecorded bank fee (fixed):** EUR 38.50 monthly service charge was on the bank statement but not booked. Posted JE-00310 to Bank Fees, supported by the bank statement (DOC-0202).
- **Deposit in transit (no fix needed):** EUR 18,200 AR receipt (JE-00308) recorded 3/31 hadn't cleared the bank yet — normal timing difference, left unmatched for April clearing.
- **Unidentified bank debit (flagged, not booked):** EUR 3,150 SEPA outflow (BT-DE-0045, ref TX-44817) has no supporting documentation or matching ledger activity anywhere. Rather than forcing a match, I logged it as EXC-001 for controller/treasury follow-up (possible unauthorized debit).

All other 18 bank lines were matched to their ledger entries. The reconciliation now ties out exactly to the one flagged exception. Memo submitted to the controller.
